title: EvidenceRef
description: Evidence resolved for one port of one attempt: exact bytes by digest, the subject they describe, who produced them, the policy they were admitted under, and how long they stay admissible. A digest identifies bytes; provenance is a claim about origin; neither asserts truth.

locator.description: Where the evidence was read from, in the port kind's locator form.

subject.description: What the evidence is about: a commit, a run, a corpus snapshot.

valid_until.description: Moment after which the evidence is no longer admissible for new work.
